hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git fetch --quiet 2>/dev/null; echo '## git'; git status -sb | head -20; echo; git log --oneline -8; echo; echo '## docs/progress.md'; cat docs/progress.md 2>/dev/null

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'npm ci failed: run it before npm run check'; echo "## cloud: node $(node -v)"
